title: Improving Out-of-Distribution Robustness via Selective Augmentation
reasoning: The paper uses the CivilComments dataset, which includes demographic features like 'Christian' and 'Muslim' to identify spurious correlations and address bias in text classification (toxic vs. non-toxic comments). However, the focus is on mitigating statistical bias related to these demographic groups, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical concepts themselves.
